_notes: IMPORTANT: this file is documentation only (curl commands, query params, which file to send).

The actual ready-to-POST request bodies live as STANDALONE files in ml/samples/, one JSON value per file with no wrapper -- so you can always do --data-binary @ml/samples/<file>.json safely without picking apart nested keys.
Query params go in the URL (?key=value), never in the JSON body -- FastAPI puts scalar route args in the query string whenever the route also has a body-model/list param.
Server must be running: bash start_ml_engine.sh (defaults to http://localhost:8000).

POST /api/v1/analyze/situation.description: Analyze current financial situation. Body = full UserDataInput profile.

POST /api/v1/analyze/goals.description: Analyze goal feasibility and recovery plans. Body = full UserDataInput profile.

POST /api/v1/analyze/comprehensive.description: Full financial plan (situation + goals + forecast + recommendations). Body = full UserDataInput profile.

POST /api/v1/expense/analyze.description: Analyze just a list of transactions. Body is a bare JSON array, NOT wrapped in an object.

POST /api/v1/forecast/cashflow.description: Forecast cash flow. 'monthly_expenses' and 'current_savings' are QUERY params; body is a bare array of income sources.

POST /api/v1/goal/feasibility.description: Feasibility for a single goal. 'monthly_surplus' is a QUERY param; body is a single GoalInput (not wrapped).

POST /api/v1/simulation/monte-carlo.description: Monte Carlo goal simulation. All parameters are QUERY params; there is no request body.

POST /api/v1/recommendations/generate.description: Generate prioritized recommendations + action plan. Body = full UserDataInput profile.

GET /api/v1/recommendations/{rec_id}/exp.description: Explain a recommendation. 'rec_id' is a PATH param; 'rec_data' is a QUERY param holding a JSON-encoded recommendation object (use --data-urlencode).

POST /api/v1/recommendation/validate.description: Validate a recommendation is financially safe. Body is {user_data, recommendation} nested (two body params combined into one object).

POST /api/v1/scenario/what-if.description: What-if scenario analysis (placeholder logic in gaie.py). 'months' is a QUERY param; body is {current_situation, scenario_changes} nested.
